## Current completed units

Reviewed covariant FLRW transport, coupled H/He cold chemistry and source subcells preserve single energy ownership and durable V4 checkpoints. Earlier completed checks and histories are reused. Five short cases passed the frozen spatial/time/angular screen; this does not establish full-history convergence.

This resume from fe789b0b completed the previously authorized one-line caller repair, pinned Rust 1.94.1 build and bounded postcache diagnostic (exit 0, 70 RHS). The first domain-endpoint and caller syntax failures remain preserved. Separate Astra review issued PASS_SCOPED_FINITE_POSTCACHE_PROFILE.

Source006 adds default-off opt-in four-column Jacobian scheduling using the existing shared eight-worker pool, with bounded actual RHS accounting and deterministic error ordering. Seven targeted tests, one release build and one diagnostic all exited 0. Across 72 fixed-fixture stages, 504 RHS and 24,626 stored state words matched. The measured chemical-stage wall ratio is 1.324001921 (serial 0.226000643 s / parallel 0.170695102 s); this is one fixture, not a full-history speedup. Separate fresh Astra review issued PASS_SCOPED_SOURCE006_OPT_IN_JACOBIAN_COLUMNS. No production deployment or new full run is authorized by this unit.

Completed source006 content commit: d3bbd732be3851fa8eff4f201e49e9e2e130bb6f. Public unit ZIP and private raw evidence backups are verified locally and independently located by Dropbox metadata. That source006-specific unit did not upload to Drive; the later integrated v2 handoff below has verified Dropbox and Drive upload receipts. Requested implementation gpt-6.1-sol/high and review gpt-6-astra/high were selected through native delegation; actual runtime model identity is NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_OBSERVED.

## Actual full005 pair completed; renderer dispatch repaired

Exact AUTO001 evidence was recovered from Dropbox on2026-10-16 KST. Q512 finished at2026-10-15 21:25:27.916253 UTC with442,146 accepted steps; Q1024 at22:28:24.534569 UTC with262,660. Both return0, a=0.2/zbar4, native completion proof true and source/config/binary readbacks match. Source005 remained unchanged and the original campaign epoch/deadline was not reset. Whole-history numerical convergence remains pending.

The owner watcher collected a513,601,000-byte declared-input archive, successfully bound both cases, then failed before rendering: main's local tuple variable run shadowed the global run() function. The exact historical failure and native receipts are now in research/flrw_full005_cli_repair_20261016/evidence/. The compact AUTO001 ZIP does not contain raw histories; cloud backup of the larger raw archive is not claimed.

This repair changes only the unused local tuple name run to run_dir. Three focused CLI dispatch tests pass, and an independent scoped review passes. Earlier physics checks and source006 diagnostics were not replayed. Actual full-history rendering was not performed in this executor: the current NCP credential/raw inputs are unavailable here, and the quota-blocked connector was not retried.

The repaired renderer retains actual source/config/all-row/ledger checks. The unchanged direct NCP wrapper bounds one bind/render invocation to300seconds,8GiB and the original2026-10-16 03:50:17.774070UTC deadline. Output figures remain full-interval diagnostics pending review; Q512/Q1024 do not establish whole-history time/angular convergence or64-core adequacy.
